frameworks.name: Next.js (App Router)
frameworks.script_component: next/script <Script> in app/layout.tsx with default strategy='afterInteractive' (note: experimental 'worker' strategy is not supported in App Router) or official @simpleanalytics/next plugin (<SimpleAnalytics /> component + withSimpleAnalytics proxy in next.config.ts)
frameworks.routing_behavior: Next.js guarantees the layout script loads only once across client-side App Router navigations; Simple Analytics and Plausible automatically track pushState route transitions (and @simpleanalytics/next supports server-side trackPageview via next/server after())
frameworks.csp_directive: script-src 'self' https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com; img-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com https://simpleanalyticsbadges.com (add 'unsafe-inline' to script-src only if using automated events; dynamic rendering required for automatic CSP nonce injection in Next.js)

frameworks.name: React 19 (Vite / SPA & SSR)
frameworks.script_component: Built-in react-dom@19.3 <script src='https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com/latest.js' async={true} /> component (providing both src and async={true} without onLoad/onError enables React automatic <head> hoisting and deduplication; defer is not recommended with streaming SSR) or standard async script in index.html
frameworks.routing_behavior: Simple Analytics automatically triggers virtual pageviews on SPA History API pushState changes (or via data-mode='hash'); Fathom Analytics supports SPA routing via data-spa='auto' or data-spa='history' on its script tag
frameworks.csp_directive: script-src 'self' https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com; img-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com https://simpleanalyticsbadges.com (supports cryptographic nonce prop on React <script nonce={...} />)

frameworks.name: Astro (Static, Islands & View Transitions)
frameworks.script_component: External <script is:inline async src='https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com/latest.js'></script> in src/layouts/Layout.astro or BaseHead.astro (is:inline opts out of Astro default ES module bundling and once-only execution)
frameworks.routing_behavior: When using Astro View Transitions (<ClientRouter /> from 'astro:transitions'), hook custom client scripts into the 'astro:page-load' lifecycle event or add 'data-astro-rerun' (Astro 4.5+); for Fathom Analytics, add data-spa='auto' to the deferred script tag
frameworks.csp_directive: script-src 'self' https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com; img-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com https://simpleanalyticsbadges.com

frameworks.name: Vue 3 (Vite / SPA & Nuxt SSR)
frameworks.script_component: Official simple-analytics-vue plugin (Vue.use(SimpleAnalytics, { skip: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' })) or @simpleanalytics/nuxt module for Nuxt 3/4, or official Plausible NPM package; in SSR setups, any direct DOM script injection must run inside the onMounted() lifecycle hook
frameworks.routing_behavior: Automatic SPA virtual pageview tracking on Vue Router pushState transitions in both Simple Analytics and Plausible; custom events triggered via injected saEvent('event_name') in Vue 3 Composition API
frameworks.csp_directive: script-src 'self' https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com; img-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com https://simpleanalyticsbadges.com

frameworks.name: Remix (Full-Stack SSR & Client Router)
frameworks.use_case: Server-Rendered Web Apps with Progressive Enhancement
frameworks.script_component: Standard <script async src='https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com/latest.js' nonce={nonce} /> placed in app/root.tsx alongside Remix's <Scripts nonce={nonce} /> runtime component (Remix manages <Scripts /> internally and does not allow passing src, async, or defer props to it)
frameworks.routing_behavior: Once <Scripts /> mounts the Remix client runtime in <body>, client-side route transitions use the browser History API and are automatically recorded as pageviews by SPA-aware analytics scripts
frameworks.csp_directive: script-src 'self' https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com; img-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com https://simpleanalyticsbadges.com (pass matching CSP nonce to both Remix <Scripts nonce={...} /> and external <script nonce={...} />)

_notes_a_verifier.csp_directive: Simple Analytics CSP domains are confirmed (script-src 'self' https://scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com; img-src 'self' https://queue.simpleanalyticscdn.com https://simpleanalyticsbadges.com), but Custom Pixels execute inside Shopify's isolated Web Worker / iframe sandbox and Plausible/Fathom CSP domains remain unconfirmed in primary docs — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-pixels-api]

frameworks.name: Shopify (Online Store 2.0 & Web Pixels API)
frameworks.script_component: Dual setup: (1) Global script snippet in Layout/theme.liquid before </head> for storefront pages (does not execute on /checkouts/* pages); (2) Custom Web Pixel in Settings > Customer events > Add custom pixel (lax sandbox) dynamically injecting the script via document.createElement('script')
frameworks.routing_behavior: Storefront navigations fire standard pageviews via theme.liquid; checkout progression and e-commerce revenue events ('page_viewed', 'product_added_to_cart', 'checkout_started', 'checkout_completed') are tracked in the Custom Pixel via analytics.subscribe() passing event.context.document.location.href and respecting api.customerPrivacy.subscribe('visitorConsentCollected')
